## Why Paper Trading Matters
Jumping into live markets with real money can be intimidating, especially for beginners. Paper trading lets you practice buying and selling securities without risking any capital. It’s a safe sandbox where you can test strategies, learn how orders work, and get comfortable with platform tools. Many traders use paper accounts to build confidence before committing real funds. Because there’s no financial loss, you can focus purely on the mechanics of trading and the psychology behind each decision.
